raw_ocr_text:
BEGINNING at a point in the Westerly line of Birchall Drive distant 576.81 feet Northwardly from the Northerly end of the curve connecting the Westerly line of Birchall Drive with the Northerly line of Kings Highway, said connecting curve having a radius of 75 feet, said beginning point being in the division line between Lots 6 and 7 on the plan hereinafter mentioned; thence

(1) Northwardly along the Westerly line of Birchall Drive 95 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 7 and 8; thence

(2) Westwardly along said division line at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.96 feet to a point in the Westerly boundary line of said plan; thence

(3) Southwardly along said boundary line forming an interior angle of 89 degrees 52 minutes with the last course the distance of 95 feet to a point in the aforementioned division line between Lots 6 and 7; thence

(4) Eastwardly along said last mentioned division line forming an interior angle of 90 degrees 08 minutes with the last course and at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.74 feet to the place of beginning.

BEING Lot 7 on Plan of Country Club Estates, made by Walter H. Macnamara C.E., dated December 1956 revised January 14, 1957. Also being Block 91, Lot 33 Tax Map Borough of Haddonfield, NJ.

notes: Checked against Book 10054 Pages 595-596 (PDF pages 5 and 1): the preamble ends "thence:" and course (4) prints "Birchell Drive", both now verbatim; a second check restored the opening "ALL THAT CERTAIN ... sinuate ..." sentence (with "of Haddonfield" handwritten below "City and County of Camden", not transcribed) and the closing BEING and COMMONLY KNOWN lines; every course matches the print. The deed is dated the 12th day of March 2014 (handwritten day); the RTF-1 affidavit says March 7, 2014. Oldest deed in chain of title for 38 Birchall Dr (Lot 7). Same legal description as book 12673/pg 546 and book 12100/pg 503. Plan of Country Club Estates by Walter H. Macnamara C.E. This deed uses only cardinal directions (Northwardly, Westwardly, Southwardly, Eastwardly) without any quadrant bearings, making closure computation impossible. Interior angles are stated in the deed text (89 deg 52 min and 90 deg 08 min) but are not bearing values.
